n: Benchmark™ Double Wall Oven 30'' Right SideOpening Door
desc: Bosch 30-Inch Double Electric Wall Oven features a 4.6-cu. ft. capacity with recessed eight broil elements for added safety and increased capacity. Utilizing an Advanced Circulation System, it evenly cooks your food in up to 30% less time by optimizing heat circulation.
hl: Operates easily with the Color TFT Control Panel
SteelTouch® buttons provide easy oven operation.
Convection Multi-Rack (Convection Pro) for even baking on all racks
Convection Multi-Rack has a third heating element and a fan (regular Convection only has two heating elements) evenly circulates air around the cavity so you get consistently even golden results.
Support heavy dishes with a Telescopic Rack
The telescopic rack moves smoothly and supports heavy dishes and casserole pans with ease, making it effortless to pull out the racks.
No guesswork with a Temperature Probe
Takes the guesswork out of cooking meats.
Pizza mode mimics the intense heat of a pizza oven to deliver artisanal pies in your kitchen.
